No. 8 of 2025
AN ACT to provide for the services of the State of Saint Lucia
for the year ending on the thirty-first day of March, two thousand and
twenty-six.
[ 6th May, 2025 ]
BE IT ENACTED by the King’s Most Excellent Majesty, by and
with the advice and consent of the House of Assembly and the Senate
of Saint Lucia, and by the authority of the same, as follows:

100
No. 8 ] Appropriation Act [ 2025
Short title
1. This Act may be cited as the Appropriation Act, 2025/2026.
Appropriation of $2,057,519,900 for services of the State of Saint Lucia
for the year 2025/2026
2. There shall be and there is hereby granted to His Majesty the
King, His Heirs and Successors for the year ending on the thirty-first
day of March, two thousand and twenty-six, the sum of two billion,
fifty-seven million, five hundred and nineteen thousand, nine hundred
dollars, to be paid and appropriated out of the General Revenue and
funds of the State of Saint Lucia for the said year in such quarterly
amounts as the Minister of Finance considers appropriate and to be
approved and to be expended in the manner and for the purposes
specified in the Schedule.
